worldcombat.skill.solarblade.summary: Gather sunlight into a blade at your side while standing still, then step forward and cut across: enemies in the arc are struck and shoved along the swing. In strong sunlight it cuts at once; in rain the blade is half as strong and gathers more slowly.
worldcombat.skill.solarblade.use.0: Close in and sweep a whole row
worldcombat.skill.solarblade.use.1: An unannounced close burst in clear weather
worldcombat.skill.solarblade.description: The blade deals %1$s physical damage to each target it sweeps.
After gathering you step %3$s blocks forward, then sweep an arc of radius %1$s blocks and %2$s degrees from the landing point.

Gathering takes %1$s of standing still and gathers about %2$s strands of blade-light; in strong sunlight it is skipped and the cut lands at once. A struck target is shoved %3$s blocks along the swing.
worldcombat.skill.solarblade.stance.thru: Thrust: a longer step, a heavier single cut and a slightly longer blade, but the arc narrows to a thin line that mostly hits what is straight ahead.
worldcombat.skill.solarblade.stance.swee: Sweep: a wider blade that catches a whole row in front, at the cost of a lighter cut and a shorter step.
worldcombat.skill.solarblade.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s it consumes %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s, and cools down for %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.solarblade.growth.0: From level %1$s the cut power steps up with level.
worldcombat.skill.solarblade.growth.1: From level %1$s the cut power steps up again.
worldcombat.skill.solarblade.growth.2: At level %1$s the cooldown from commit drops to %2$s.
On (thrust): step further (x1.5), a heavier cut (x1.25) and a slightly longer blade, but the arc narrows to a thin line (x0.42) that mostly hits what is straight ahead, with 1 tick more recovery. Off (sweep): a wider blade (x1.25 degrees) that catches a whole row, at the cost of a lighter cut and a shorter step.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first instead of stepping out; higher means it chases further to cut.
On: prefers the target whose arc catches the most enemies; off: ranks by ordinary melee priority.
On: raises priority in strong sunlight, when the cut lands at once with full power; off: weather is ignored.
